thread:
sasha: :rotating_light: heads-up — incidentbot stopped attaching PagerDuty links to pages starting ~1732109000. Pages are getting redispatched every 2m and on-call can't ack because there's no PD link. seeing customer-impact reports.

pagerbot: system: failed to create PD incident: 502 Bad Gateway from pd-api.redwood.net; payload_id=abc123; retrying in 30s
```
POST /v1/incidents -> 502 Bad Gateway
{"error":"upstream_down"}
```

maria: what's the immediate impact? which services/customers affected?

sasha: quick summary: ~6 pages for svc-auth, 3 for embed-queue. chris (oncall) reports pages with only text "incident: 12345" and no PD link. one customer escalated to support at 15:12.

chris: I got the flood of pages but no PD links — can't ack from PD console. pages keep coming every 2 minutes with same payload id.

alan: looking at the incidentbot logs — token refresh to PD failed at 1732109153. see snippet:
```
Error: AuthError: token expired
at PDClient._request (/srv/incidentbot/lib/pd_client.js:124:22)
Response: 401 {"error":"token_expired"}
```

devops: immediate mitigation proposal: disable auto-redispatch and stop the retry loop. then manually create PD incidents for outstanding pages and paste links here. command:
```
./scripts/ops/toggle_ff --env prod --flag incidentbot_redispatch --off
```

ops-bot: executed toggle: incidentbot_redispatch=false (initiated by devops) at 1732110400

maria: ops: please create PD incidents for the 9 outstanding pages and paste links here, then SMS the oncall list. chris can you confirm once you have links?

chris: confirmed, got two manual PD links from ops, acked them. repeated pages stopped for those incidents. thanks.

sasha: rolling a hotfix to incidentbot to avoid dropping attachment payload on retry. PR: https://git.redwood/company/incidentbot/pull/452 (patch changes retry handling + preserves attachments)

alan: hotfix deployed to canary us-east-1 at 1732111800 — monitoring logs for PD success. initial canary shows PD POSTs succeed and attachments included.

devops: root-cause hypothesis: token rotation failed due to a transient KMS blip; incidentbot treated 401 as retriable but truncated attachment before retrying, resulting in PD incidents with no links and then redispatch loops. fix: treat 401 as fatal for that attempt and requeue full payload after token refresh. unit test added.

maria: customer-impact summary for postmortem: 4 customers experienced delayed acknowledgements (~20-30m delay). one mid-tier customer triggered a support SLO miss and needs a follow-up from CS.

chris: added incident IDs to the tracker (INC-2026, INC-2027) and updated oncall handoff notes. will include manual steps in the runbook.

sasha: follow-ups: 1) postmortem with timeline and ticketed CS follow-up, 2) audit token rotation and add alerting, 3) add e2e test that validates attachments survive retry paths.

devops: noted. also scheduling a run of the rotation audit tomorrow 09:00 PST.

sasha: thanks all — keeping this thread for final incident notes and actions. :thumbsup:
